verdict.rationale: OpenRouter docs state that enterprise customers can enable in-region routing so prompts/completions are processed and stay within a selected EU or US region, and non-enterprise users can restrict routing to providers with certain data policies. However, this region-residency control is explicitly gated to 'enterprise customers,' not available to typical AI-native self-serve users, and community commentary notes there are 'no true guarantees of ZDR/privacy/data sovereignty' for the general product. missing for 10: self-serve (non-enterprise) region selection, independent verification of the enterprise in-region guarantee, and broader regional options beyond EU/US.
